key_moments: Ousmane Dembélé scored a stunning first-half hat-trick within 32 minutes to put France in complete control [1.2.6].
Jørgen Strand Larsen missed a penalty in the 50th minute, which was saved by French goalkeeper Mike Maignan.
Désiré Doué sealed the 4-1 victory with a stoppage-time header in the 94th minute.

standout_performers.reason: Scored a brilliant first-half hat-trick to secure the victory and top spot in the group [1.2.6].
Provided two assists for Dembélé and was a constant threat on the wing.
Scored Norway's only goal with a composed finish in the first half.

matches.tactical_summary: France dominated the match early on, utilizing Kylian Mbappé's playmaking and Ousmane Dembélé's clinical finishing to exploit a heavily rotated Norwegian defense. Despite Norway's brief resurgence after Aasgaard's goal, France maintained control in the second half, sealing the victory with a late stoppage-time header from Désiré Doué.

narrative: Ousmane Dembélé's spectacular first-half hat-trick propelled France to a dominant 4-1 victory over a heavily rotated Norway side, securing top spot in Group I with a perfect group-stage record. Despite resting Erling Haaland, Norway advanced to the Round of 32 in second place, where they will face Ivory Coast.
